The lecture covers the virtues of fasting, its role in controlling sexual desires in an increasingly hypersexualized society, and the historical stages of fasting legislation. Sheikh explains how fasting was progressively obligated upon the Muslim community in three distinct stages, transitioning from optional with an alternative (feeding the poor) to fully obligatory as it exists today, emphasizing how Islamic legislation adjusted gradually to build discipline in society.
suggested_title: The History and Stages of Fasting Legislation in Islam - Zadul-Ma'ad Part 68
catchy_title: Three Stages: How Fasting Became Obligatory
